data.narrative:
Until, a Series A biotech company founded by Laura Deming and Hunter Davis, has raised $106M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 3 public peers in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-stage companies including Colossal Biosciences, Abridge, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

A stage-progression method is the primary applicable approach. Using total raised ($106M) as a proxy for post-money valuation and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the next stage yields $212M. Peer-median analysis is not viable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparable data within the narrow Biotech & Health peer set. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied because Until's revenue is not disclosed, limiting use of the public median P/S multiple of 5.5x across the three public tickers.

The triangulated valuation range is $180M–$244M, with a median point of $212M. This estimate carries material uncertainty: it rests on a single methodological pillar and typical stage-progression multiples rather than company-specific metrics. Key unknowns include Until's revenue trajectory, burn rate, and clinical development milestones—all material to biotech valuation but absent from available data. The range should be treated as preliminary pending disclosure of financial performance or additional peer comparables.
